I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging (account code TSP). It froze when scanning the bill-of-lading barcode. Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, and confirmed it was Tansleigh, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself.

I left out ticket #4912, a separate Door 6 "phantom lock" issue. It only shows up in a forwarded deal-desk email that I couldn't confirm Hollis has access to.
